changes: Moved real safe header edits into General: player name, level, sex, current XP, needed XP.
Added common editable inventory values to General for existing mapped Gold and Lockpick rows.
General save writes through fixed-size header patching and exact inventory payload-offset patching.
General Save Copy writes a separate edited save, and in-place Save Edits creates a backup first.
File menu Save Edits / Save Copy now routes General, Player Inventory, and Raw Editor by active page.
Renamed Raw Editor -> Quick Code Formats to Quick Codes.
Split Quick Codes into Builder, Decoder, and Reference internal tabs to reduce clutter.
safety: General only enables common inventory values when the loaded save already has an editable mapped row.
Missing Gold/Lockpick rows remain disabled rather than being guessed or blindly inserted.
General in-place saves stage edits to a temporary file before replacing the loaded save.
